single_terminal_success_rule: READY_FOR_PRODUCTION is the single terminal success enum value for Roadmap 1.
ready_event_rule: The externally named milestone/event may qualify the aggregate as studio.episode.ready_for_production; no second state value is introduced.

lock_transition.rule: A successful screenplay lock transitions SCREENPLAY_REVIEW -> LOCKED -> READY_FOR_PRODUCTION atomically or through an idempotently resumable two-command sequence; implementation must document which.

post_lock_rule: Content mutation after lock always derives a new ProductionRevision with the locked revision as parent.
